items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Happy Joe had this thing he used to keep behind the counter; he called it a shillelagh.

ctx.x: a club downtown that was really kind of wild. This first club that I used to play for my teacher was a really nice club, where people came and they danced and it was quiet and everything. This particular club featured... It was called Happy Joe's. It was on Ninth Street between G and H. I don't remember ever seeing anybody come in there but Irish people. Happy Joe had this thing he used to keep behind the counter; he called it a shillelagh. And every night, without fail, a fight started of some kind, and he'd…

But what would happen, the guy would tell us to play fast music. I remember we used to play things like "Dinah," some kind of fast thing like "Limehouse Blues" or something -- play very fast. Sometimes there'd be people fighting... I actually saw one guy had another guy on the dance floor, and raise his fist back to hit him, and the guy said something to him, and they realized that they were together! So they got up and ran over to a corner and started fighting somebody else. And after that... And I remind you,…
